releaseNotesSummary: Unsigned pre-1.0 hotfix release for the Start Menu guided-startup handoff. v0.1.0-pre.37 includes the v0.1.0-pre.36 PowerShell 5.1 Start Menu usability and long-run status improvements, then hardens the release-root Start-ShareSurfer.ps1 launcher so it invokes Start-ShareSurfer and Start-ShareSurferStartup from the imported ShareSurfer module instance instead of relying on ambiguous command resolution. After guided startup writes the startup JSON, operator plan, and rerun script, the menu now exits cleanly with next-step guidance instead of immediately re-entering the menu loop, avoiding the repeated helper-resolution errors reported in v0.1.0-pre.35. The package includes the built PowerShell module files, startup launcher, diagnostic scripts, documentation, hashes, release manifest, dependency-age report, and prebuilt standalone dashboard template assets.
